lead_raw_text:
The La4Mg10Co2 structure (reduced formula La2Mg5Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows Co centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors, while La centers have 20 neighbors and Mg centers display 11- and 12-neighbor environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Co and Mg coordination polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites.
